[[File:Stuart Jones DecipherCon 1999 SAT.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Stuart Jones at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Stuart Jones''' made the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] final twelve. Jones qualified through Calamari Brisbane from Melbourne, Victoria.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="trando">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050517110350/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/wf00p2.htm History of the World Finals], [[Trandosite]].</ref> Jones won the [[1997 Calamari Regionals (Melbourne)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I'm 21 years of age, from Surrey Hills, a Melbourne suburb. I'd only been playing Star Wars CCG for four months prior to winning the Calamari Regional. I study Accounting at a Melbourne university, enjoy tennis and 'Footy' (Australian Rules Football, or Rugby), and I also play Magic: The Gathering. My favorite line in Star Wars is, 'Only a master of evil, Darth'."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/jones.html Stuart Jones], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427213055/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/jones.html Internet Archive]</ref>
